Common Inquiries

What documents do I need to apply?

+

You will usually need a valid driver's license, proof of address, work authorization, and any platform documents required for your work type.

Is insurance included in the weekly price?

+

Insurance options can be included depending on the plan, vehicle, and driver profile. The team confirms this before you collect a vehicle.

How long does approval typically take?

+

Most complete applications can be reviewed within 24 hours. Missing documents or insurance checks can add time.

Can I cancel my plan at any time?

+

Plans are designed around weekly flexibility. Your agreement will show the notice period, payment schedule, and return requirements clearly.
